answer: Sybil farms exist to pool their payouts, so make pooling the tell. A new agent's earnings sit in a garden account that unlocks only after 20 epochs. When several identities sweep coins into one wallet, the ledger acts as a prism: it splits that inflow back to its sources, merges those identities into one claimant and claws back the extra rewards. An operator can still run ten personas, but must spend from ten wallets that never touch, and the first consolidation lights the whole cluster up like a lantern.
